analogy.rationale: Adenosine reuptake inhibitors block SLC29A1 (ENT1), raising extracellular adenosine and thereby engaging adenosine receptors; cells in this panel express adenosine receptors variably, so the transcriptional response is expected to be weak and most similar to other adenosine-pathway modulators, with some overlap with other monoamine/adenosine transporter inhibitors.
